test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Among seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, U and V; U is taller than only three other friends. R is tallest among all friends. T is taller than U. Q is taller than only one person. Only two persons are taller than P. V is taller than Q. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
solution:
Given: Seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, U and V. 

R is tallest among all friends.

R > __ > __ > __ > __ > __ > __

Q is taller than only one person.

R > __ > __ > __ > __ > Q > __

U is taller than only three other friends.

Only two persons are taller than P.

R > __ > P > U > __ > Q > __

T is taller than U. 

R > T > P > U > __ > Q > __

V is taller than Q. 

R > T > P > U > V > Q > __

And, S will placed at the remaining place.

So, **"S"** is the shortest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"S"**.
